scope: Analyze the current precision/Figma gaps one by one using primary literature, public book chapters/metadata and official standards; do not implement or certify the proposals.
documentCoverage: Only the new research section and corrected numeric-vector count; historical sections not recertified.

probes.filter: unit-area tent integrated against the source/destination unit-pixel overlap

coordinateCounterexample.scope: Valid affine arithmetic counterexample; not a new full-frame rendering test or attribution of every existing texture difference.

probes.runtimeAcceptance: Not run; these are analysis-only mathematical probes.

runtimeTestsThisTurn: Not rerun: production and test sources unchanged; do not attribute previous 320/202 passes to this research turn.

references.title: Goldberg, What Every Computer Scientist Should Know About Floating-Point Arithmetic
references.scopeBoundary: Rounding/cancellation principles; not a complete renderer proof.

references.title: Higham, Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, second edition
references.type: book, author page and available preview
references.scopeBoundary: Book metadata/rounding-error foundations checked; not claimed to have read the full paid book.

references.title: WGSL 15.7.5 Reassociation and Fusion
references.scopeBoundary: Source parentheses do not guarantee evaluation identity.

references.title: Neal, Fast Exact Summation Using Small and Large Superaccumulators
references.scopeBoundary: Exact sum and final rounding; exact dot product must also preserve product bits.

references.title: Demmel, Ahrens, Nguyen, Efficient Reproducible Floating Point Summation and BLAS
references.scopeBoundary: Reproducibility and reduction design; not automatic correctly rounded convolution.

references.title: Shewchuk, Adaptive Precision Floating-Point Arithmetic and Fast Robust Geometric Predicates
references.scopeBoundary: Adaptive exact-predicate method; needs a new proof for this affine/floor decision.

references.title: Manson and Schaefer, Analytic Rasterization of Curves with Polynomial Filters
references.scopeBoundary: Boundary integrals; nonoverlapping-shape assumption must not be omitted.

references.title: Figma, Desperately seeking squircles
references.scopeBoundary: Bezier/circular smoothing construction; current implementation still requires fresh contour validation.

references.title: Farin, Curves and Surfaces for CAGD, fifth edition
references.type: book, author table of contents; publisher metadata checked
references.scopeBoundary: Bezier derivatives/subdivision foundations; not a source of a certified current Figma formula.

references.title: Rong and Tan, Jump Flooding in GPU with Applications to Voronoi Diagram and Distance Transform
references.scopeBoundary: Approximate grid distance transform; not proven as the cause of current backend drift.

references.title: Felzenszwalb and Huttenlocher, Distance Transforms of Sampled Functions
references.scopeBoundary: Exact sampled-grid EDT; not exact distance to continuous vector boundaries.

references.title: Cao, Tang, Mohamed, Tan, Parallel Banding Algorithm
references.type: author project page, paper and addendum
references.scopeBoundary: Exact GPU EDT candidate; CUDA performance not extrapolated to WebGL2.

references.title: Physically Based Rendering, fourth edition: Specular Reflection and Transmission
references.scopeBoundary: Snell/Fresnel reference; does not imply Figma uses that physical model.

references.title: Figma Effect API
references.scopeBoundary: Glass/texture/progressive blur parameter definitions; implementation is not disclosed.

references.title: Perlin, Improved Noise reference implementation
references.type: author code corresponding to SIGGRAPH paper
references.scopeBoundary: Candidate smooth gradient noise; not evidence that Figma uses it.

references.title: Jarzynski and Olano, Hash Functions for GPU Rendering
references.scopeBoundary: Deterministic integer hash candidates/statistical quality; not a visual matching guarantee.

references.title: Physically Based Rendering, fourth edition: Texture Sampling and Antialiasing
references.scopeBoundary: Sampling footprint/bandwidth analysis.

references.title: Physically Based Rendering, fourth edition: Image Texture
references.scopeBoundary: MIP/EWA candidates; weights, rounding and boundaries must be separately specified for byte parity.

references.title: Porter and Duff, Compositing Digital Images
references.scopeBoundary: Premultiplied alpha and explicit assumptions about subpixel overlap.

references.title: W3C Compositing and Blending Level 1
references.scopeBoundary: Compositing/group semantics; not Figma intermediate quantization specification.

references.title: ICC.1 v4 Specification
references.scopeBoundary: Color profile contract; current constant-image tests do not establish general image resampling.

references.title: ITU-R BT.2100
references.scopeBoundary: PQ/HLG and HDR signal definitions.

priority: Exact rational filter/reference at radius 2.5; expand domain only with capacity proof.
Texture cell/coordinate contract and staged glass readbacks.
Shared analytic coverage/compositor across native and browser APIs.
Current Figma smoothing contour and blur-response calibration.
Explicit effect parameters, nonuniform color-managed images and full combinations.
limits: Literature supplies algorithms and assumptions, not private Figma internals.
Exact grid EDT is not continuous vector distance.
Reproducible accumulation is not necessarily exact or correctly rounded.
Better noise/filtering/physical rendering is not automatically Figma matching.
The lattice probe is an arithmetic counterexample, not a fresh full-frame attribution.
No performance claims from the cited CPU/CUDA benchmarks are transferred to this renderer.
